description: Create all 6 reusable auth widgets and all 4 auth screens (Splash, Login, OTP, CompleteProfile). Depends on FEAT-001 (AuthProvider, AuthUser, MockAuthService must exist). Independent of FEAT-003 (main.dart wiring).
steps: Create lib/widgets/auth/ directory. Create lib/widgets/auth/primary_button.dart: a full-width pill-shaped ElevatedButton using AppColors.freshGreen, AppTextStyles.buttonText, with loading state (CircularProgressIndicator replaces text when isLoading=true). Props: String label, VoidCallback? onPressed, bool isLoading=false.

Create lib/widgets/auth/social_button.dart: a full-width pill button for Google (white bg, border) and Apple (dark bg). Props: String label, IconData icon, Color backgroundColor, Color textColor, VoidCallback? onPressed. Used for the non-functional social login buttons.

Create lib/widgets/auth/phone_field.dart: a Row with a +91 flag prefix container (non-tappable, white card style) and a TextFormField for the phone number. Shows inline error text below if validator fails. Uses AppColors, AppDimensions from theme. Props: TextEditingController controller, String? errorText, ValueChanged<String>? onChanged.

Create lib/widgets/auth/otp_boxes_row.dart: a Row of 6 individual digit containers (each ~48x56, white card with border). Active box (matching cursor position) gets a green border (AppColors.freshGreen, width 2). Filled box shows the digit in AppTextStyles.h3. Props: String value (0-6 chars), int activeIndex, bool hasError (triggers red borders + shake animation via AnimationController). No TextFields inside — controlled entirely by the parent numeric keypad. Include a shake animation using an AnimationController + CurvedAnimation + Tween<Offset> with SlideTransition.

Create lib/widgets/auth/numeric_keypad.dart: a grid of 12 keys (1-9, empty, 0, backspace). Each key is a GestureDetector with an InkWell, 64x64 round container. Digit keys show the number in Poppins bold. Backspace shows Icons.backspace_outlined. Props: ValueChanged<String> onDigitPressed, VoidCallback onBackspace. This widget replaces the system keyboard on the OTP screen.

Create lib/widgets/auth/step_chip.dart: a small pill-shaped container showing step info (e.g. 'Step 2 of 3 • Brewing Account'). Uses AppColors.deepGreenLight background, AppColors.deepGreen text, AppTextStyles.labelSmall. Props: String text.

Create lib/screens/splash_screen.dart. StatefulWidget. initState: calls Future.delayed(Duration(seconds: 2)) then checks AuthProvider (context.read).isLoggedIn. If logged in → replace route with BrewBuddyShell (import from main.dart via a named route OR push replacement). If not → LoginScreen. Build: centered Column with BrewBuddy circular logo (green circle 120x120 with ☕ emoji or assets/images/logo.png if it exists as an Image.asset), app name 'BrewBuddy' in AppTextStyles.h1.copyWith(color: AppColors.deepGreen), subtitle in AppTextStyles.bodySmall. Background: AppColors.cream. Use FutureBuilder or override initState with WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback for navigation after build.

Create lib/screens/login_screen.dart. StatefulWidget. Has: TextEditingController _phoneController, GlobalKey<FormState> _formKey, String? _phoneError. Build layout (SingleChildScrollView, cream background): (a) Top row: close (X) IconButton (right) + small logo (left, 32x32 green circle with ☕), (b) Large circular BrewBuddy logo (100x100 green circle), (c) Headline 'Welcome to BrewBuddy' in AppTextStyles.h2, subtitle text in AppTextStyles.bodyMedium.copyWith(color: AppColors.mediumGrey), (d) Two feature chips in a Row: 'FREE DRINK ON 150★' and 'FAST COUNTER PICKUP' — pill containers with AppColors.successGreenLight background and AppColors.freshGreen text, (e) White card (AppDecorations.card, padding 20) containing: label 'Mobile Number', PhoneField widget, helper text 'We will send a 6-digit verification code' in AppTextStyles.bodySmall, SizedBox(height:16), PrimaryButton 'Continue →' that validates phone (isValidIndianMobile check — 10 digits, starts 6-9), sets _phoneError inline if invalid, otherwise calls context.read<AuthProvider>().sendOtp(phone) then pushes OtpScreen, (f) Divider with 'or continue with' text, (g) SocialButton 'Continue with Google' (white), SocialButton 'Continue with Apple' (dark), both show a SnackBar 'Demo only: please use mobile number login', (h) TextButton 'Browse Cafe Menu as Guest' → calls authProvider.loginAsGuest() then Navigator.pushAndRemoveUntil to BrewBuddyShell, (i) Terms/Privacy text with underlined RichText spans (no navigation). Phone validation: RegExp(r'^[6-9]\d{9}$').hasMatch(phone).

Create lib/screens/otp_screen.dart. StatefulWidget. Constructor: required String phone. State fields: String _otp = '' (0-6 chars), int _activeIndex = 0, Timer? _resendTimer, int _resendSeconds = 30, bool _isAutoDetecting = true, AnimationController? _shakeController, bool _isVerifying = false. initState: start _resendTimer counting down from 30 each second (setState, cancel at 0, set resendEnabled=true); start a Future.delayed(Duration(seconds: 3)) that auto-fills '123456' by setting _otp and _activeIndex=6 and cancels auto-detect. dispose: cancel timer, dispose AnimationController. Build layout (Column, no scroll — keyboard takes bottom): (a) AppBar: back arrow, title 'Verify OTP', step chip 'Step 2 of 3 • Brewing Account', '256-Bit SSL' badge row, (b) Heading 'Verify your number', subtext 'Enter the 6-digit code sent to +91 {phone}' with 'Edit' chip (Navigator.pop), (c) Auto-detecting card: white card with spinner + 'Auto-detecting SMS OTP' text — hides when _isAutoDetecting becomes false (after 3s), (d) OtpBoxesRow(value: _otp, activeIndex: _activeIndex, hasError: _hasError), (e) Resend row: 'Resend code in 00:{seconds}' text when counting, 'Resend OTP' TextButton enabled only when _resendSeconds==0 (restarts timer, resets _otp), (f) '50 Bonus Stars will be unlocked...' green banner, (g) PrimaryButton 'Verify & Continue →' isLoading:_isVerifying — calls _verifyOtp(), (h) 'Didn't receive SMS? Contact Roastery Care' TextButton (SnackBar), (i) Expanded spacer, (j) NumericKeypad — onDigitPressed: if _otp.length < 6, append digit, advance activeIndex; onBackspace: remove last char, retreat activeIndex. OTP verify logic: calls authProvider.verifyOtp(phone, _otp). On null result: trigger shake animation, clear _otp, show 'Invalid code. Try again.' snackbar. On success: if authProvider.isNewUser → push CompleteProfileScreen; else → pushAndRemoveUntil BrewBuddyShell. Debug-only hint: if (kDebugMode) show 'Demo code: 123456' label above keypad.

Create lib/screens/complete_profile_screen.dart. StatefulWidget. Constructor: required String phone. State: TextEditingController _nameController, TextEditingController _emailController, DateTime? _selectedDob, bool _whatsappUpdates = true, bool _isSaving = false, GlobalKey<FormState> _formKey. Build layout (SingleChildScrollView): (a) AppBar: back arrow, title 'Complete Profile', 'Step 3 of 3' chip on left, 'Skip for now' TextButton on right (pushAndRemoveUntil to BrewBuddyShell with name='Guest user'), (b) Welcome gift card: green gradient container (AppDecorations.deepGreenGradient), icon 🎁, text 'You're 1 step away from your first Stars. Complete your details to unlock a Free Welcome Beverage + 20 Bonus Stars on your first sip.', (c) Form with: TextFormField for Full Name (required, validator: must not be empty), TextFormField for Date of Birth (readOnly, onTap: shows showDatePicker with lastDate: now - 10 years, helper text 'For your birthday reward'), TextFormField for Email Address (optional, validator: if non-empty must match basic email regex), (d) SwitchListTile 'WhatsApp Updates' with _whatsappUpdates state, (e) Row with lock icon + 'Encrypted & Protected by BrewBuddy Privacy' in AppTextStyles.bodySmall, (f) PrimaryButton 'Get Started' isLoading:_isSaving — validates form, calls authProvider.saveProfile(...), then calls userProvider.addStars(20) for welcome stars, then pushAndRemoveUntil to BrewBuddyShell. Import both AuthProvider and UserProvider.
acceptance_criteria: All 6 widgets in lib/widgets/auth/ compile cleanly
SplashScreen shows for ~2s then navigates (no route errors)
LoginScreen renders logo, chips, phone card, social buttons, guest link
OtpScreen: numeric keypad types into OTP boxes; auto-fill fires after 3s with '123456'; shake animation fires on wrong code; resend countdown works; debug hint visible in debug mode
CompleteProfileScreen: date picker opens; skip goes to home as 'Guest user'; save calls authProvider.saveProfile

findings: SCREENS CREATED: SplashScreen (lib/screens/splash_screen.dart), LoginScreen (lib/screens/login_screen.dart), OtpScreen (lib/screens/otp_screen.dart), CompleteProfileScreen (lib/screens/complete_profile_screen.dart). WIDGETS CREATED: PrimaryButton, SocialButton, PhoneField, OtpBoxesRow, NumericKeypad, StepChip in lib/widgets/auth/. CONSTRUCTORS: SplashScreen() — no args. LoginScreen() — no args. OtpScreen({required String phone}). CompleteProfileScreen({required String phone}). NAVIGATION FLOW: Splash → Login (if not logged in) or BrewBuddyShell (if logged in). Login → OtpScreen(phone). OtpScreen → CompleteProfileScreen(phone) if isNewUser, else BrewBuddyShell. CompleteProfile → BrewBuddyShell. All screens import BrewBuddyShell from '../main.dart'. AUTHPROVIDER DEPENDENCY: All screens consume AuthProvider via context.read<AuthProvider>(). CompleteProfileScreen also reads UserProvider for addStars(20). MAIN.DART WIRING NEEDED (FEAT-003): AuthProvider must be added to MultiProvider in main.dart. The app's home should be SplashScreen (not BrewBuddyShell). SplashScreen calls authProvider.checkSession() indirectly (it checks isLoggedIn, which requires AuthProvider already initialised via FEAT-001's AuthProvider.create() or checkSession() called before runApp). Recommended pattern: in main() call AuthProvider.create() and inject into MultiProvider, then set home: const SplashScreen().
